messages:
Maria Chen: Quick follow-up from today's outage — we need to lock down customer-facing language and assign clear owners/timelines for the postmortem action items. I can draft a short external summary but need clarity on what we share publicly vs private RCA.
Ashwin Patel: +1. For status page wording: keep it brief, what impacted, what we did to mitigate, and if there's ongoing risk. Avoid root-cause detail in the public blurb.
Emily R.: Agree. Also we should include an ETA for a more detailed update (e.g., 'Detailed update within 72 hours') so customers know when to expect more.
Sophie (Support): Customers are already spamming support. If we put 'detailed update in 72h' we need to have something to send them at that time — who owns that? CSMs need the short summary and any canned responses.
Maria Chen: Proposal: status page message + one-paragraph external summary + a private (but searchable) RCA for customers under NDA or on request. Owner for external summary = Emily. Owner for the detailed customer-facing packet = Sophie (Support) with Legal review. Owner for internal RCA = Noah.
Noah (Eng Lead): I'll own the internal RCA and the action items list. I'll convert the postmortem tasks into JIRA tickets and link them. Tentative timeline: internal RCA draft in 48h, final in 96h. Action owners assigned within 24h.
Ashwin Patel: For the status page copy, suggestion: "We experienced degraded text-generation service from 14:23–15:06 UTC due to an autoscaling regression. Service has been restored. We are investigating the root cause and will provide a detailed update within 72 hours." Thoughts?
Emily R.: That reads well. Consider swapping 'autoscaling regression' for 'capacity autoscaling issue' — less jargon. Also add: 'No customer data was exposed' if true.
Maria Chen: Confirmed: no customer data exposed. Add that sentence. Final proposed status page line (Emily to post):
```
Incident: Degraded text-generation service (14:23–15:06 UTC). Service restored. No customer data exposed. We are investigating root cause and will provide a detailed update within 72 hours.
```
Ashwin Patel: :+1: 
IncidentBot: Incident #2026-112 marked RESOLVED by deployment pipeline.
Sophie (Support): I'll prepare the customer-facing FAQ and canned replies. ETA 48h. Need the one-paragraph summary from Emily to include in responses.
Emily R.: I'll draft the one-paragraph external summary now and send to Sophie + Legal for sign-off. Expect it in ~6 hours.
Noah (Eng Lead): On recurring patterns — ops team: please add any historical incidents with similar autoscaling symptoms to the RCA appendix. I want to see if this is a recurring pattern before we finalize mitigations.
Ashwin Patel: I'll pull the incident history and attach links. If we identify recurrence, we should prioritize an autoscaling resilience project.
Maria Chen: Action-item tracker:
- EMILY: external 1-paragraph summary, due +6h.
- SOPHIE: customer packet & canned replies, due 48h.
- NOAH: internal RCA draft + ticketize action items, due 48h; final RCA 96h.
- ASHWIN: attach historical incidents, due 24h.
We'll run a 30-min postmortem sync tomorrow at 10:00 UTC to review the tracker. Sophie will coordinate invites.
Noah (Eng Lead): I'll include severity/impact metrics (p95 latency, error rates, requests/sec) in the RCA.
Sophie (Support): Scheduling invites now. Also looping in Legal for language review.
Maria Chen: Thanks everyone. Reminder: public status page update goes out once Emily posts and Sophie confirms canned replies ready. Keep updates in this thread so we have a single source of truth. :eyes:
